infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Woof uses the camera only when you choose to take a pet photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Woof uses your photo library only when you choose a pet or profile photo.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Woof can use your location while the app is open to find nearby pet-friendly places and matches.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Woof to use your location while the app is open to find nearby pet-friendly places and matches.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Woof to use the camera when you choose to take a pet photo.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Woof to use photos you explicitly select.
